additional_info.subject: Site visit
additional_info.body:
MP / R3 170001698
- Touch screen is not working after software update to v7.0.5-0-gd66ba3a. Francisco supported remote, the screen is remote "useable" but does not react on touch.
- RFID reader is not working after software update to v7.0.5-0-gd66ba3a
Common factor is that both are connected with USB to the PLC KF1.
MP / R3 170001697
- Backoffice does not have connection. OCPP router has LAN cable. When OCPP ID from
170001698 is used it comes online. Issue is on Gabriels backoffice
- RFID reader is not working, opened RAFI RFID plastic back cover. There is no RFID reader inthere.
- USB cable from PLC to RFID reader is missing.

additional_info.subject: Site visit
additional_info.body:
19snUd: Non working touch Dlogic screen
USB cable from working HMI touch (Y7zd3F) connected to PLC (19snUd). The charger registers the touch when touching the screen from the other charger. This indicates that PLC is OK and reacts to data send over USB from HMI touch.
Also the RFID scanner works when I hold my phone on the RFID reader.
Otherway around does not work.
- HMI Dlogic touch on 19snUd is not working.
- USB cable between PLC and RFID used to get other charger Y7zd3F fully operational.
Y7zd3F: Missing RFID reader and OCPP offine
OCPP ID was set incorrect in SCB, corrected this and charger is online on OCPP router.
Picked up old RFID reader from customer location and used USB cable for RFID from other charger
19snUd.
- This charger is fully operational.
